evidence: the emergence of artificial intelligence has provided additional tools for those who perpetrate these attacks, including through social engineering, the development of customized malware, and an enhanced ability to evade detection

Attachments crafted with artificial intelligence tools could directly attack information systems with greater speed and/or efficiency than a human threat actor or create more effective phishing emails

Use of artificial intelligence by our employees, whether authorized or unauthorized, increases the risk that our intellectual property and other proprietary information will be unintentionally disclosed

have established an Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI usage policy to establish guidelines for the acceptable and responsible use of AI and Generative AI tools by employees, contractors, and authorized third parties
ai_positioning.summary: JOE adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, percevant principalement les risques cybersécurité et de divulgation de propriété intellectuelle. La société met en place des politiques de gouvernance pour encadrer l'usage interne de l'IA par ses employés.
